results.name: header counts are derived from the loaded list
submitted request offers Set priority as the primary step
triaged request offers Claim as the primary step, with change priority and cancel secondary
after an owner-confirmed claim the next step becomes Start processing (mock write)
another holder's claim shows no primary step
own processing request offers Resolve as the primary step
receipt groups consultation and pharmacy charges
medicine charges show the Pharmacy name
selecting an invoice updates the context band
rupee input previews the exact paise submitted
Change invoice moves focus to the register
patient band shows last visit and visit count
amended visit lists both versions in record history
opening the earlier version shows the earlier-version notice
revoked prescription stays visible with a Revoked label
